findings.description: Dora (Dorothea) Dobrotić and Franjo (Franciscus) Korotaj had a son Jacobus (Jakob) Korotaj, baptised 3 April 1871 in the parish of Križovljan Radovečki, Varaždin, Croatia; the index spells the surname Korota.
supporting_sources: Croatia, Church Books, 1516-1994 — entry for Jacobus Korota, baptised 3 Apr 1871 at Križovljan Radovečki, Roman Catholic, parents Franciscus Korota and Dorothea Dobrotić
